synthesizer_contract.inputs: Only the five separately frozen M26 role RAW files.
synthesizer_contract.shared_context_non_isolation_risk: Five role-bound passes were executed sequentially in one coordinated model context. Blob freezing prevents later rewriting; it does not create cognitive independence.
synthesizer_contract.reconciliation_rule: Resolve by evidence scope, authority and falsifiers; never by majority.

reconciliation.apparent_conflict: Innovation selects NO_ACTION_SUPPORTED while Architecture, Authority and Coverage select VERIFY_FIRST.
reconciliation.resolution: Scopes differ. Innovation rejects runtime intervention because no defect is demonstrated; the other roles require evidence-only current verification. Therefore no runtime repair is supported, while current-state closure is also not supported.
reconciliation.preserved_uncertainty: Current semantic equivalence, authority linkage and current consumer totality remain unverified.

reconciliation.apparent_conflict: Performance selects NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE while integrated state is VERIFY_FIRST.
reconciliation.resolution: VERIFY_FIRST describes the next governed action. The performance claim itself remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE until matched workload, complete clocks and intervention boundary exist.
reconciliation.preserved_uncertainty: No causal speedup or regression magnitude is asserted.

reconciliation.apparent_conflict: All 38 caller objects and 21 frozen triggers still resolve, yet 22/38 current md5(prosrc) differ.
reconciliation.resolution: Object continuity does not imply definition or route equivalence. The historical hash serialization is not canonically proven, so the 16/22 split is empirical under md5(prosrc), not a proof of historical hash method.
reconciliation.preserved_uncertainty: Canonical historical hash representation remains UNKNOWN.

reconciliation.apparent_conflict: Frozen P0 is internally complete, while current bounded scans expose many complements outside P0.
reconciliation.resolution: P0 is valid as a frozen historical denominator. Pattern and lexical complements are candidate current objects, not automatically material runtime consumers.
reconciliation.preserved_uncertainty: An authoritative current universe predicate and materiality classification are still needed.

integrated_findings.claim: P0 does not demonstrate a material runtime/product defect; receipt 38 remains a valid historical soak receipt.
All 38 frozen caller objects and all 21 frozen triggers still resolve, but current semantic equivalence is not certified because 22/38 caller bodies differ under md5(prosrc).
Current bounded scans expose complements outside P0, but static pattern/lexical occurrence does not prove runtime materiality.
Available timing rows are descriptive only; null/zero clocks, unmatched cohorts and overlapping stage accounting prevent causal performance claims.
The read-only boundary is intentional; lack of EXECUTE is not a functional failure. Material actor independence and canonical event authority remain unverified.
Existing cache/context/manifest surfaces argue for reuse-first verification rather than adding a new runtime mechanism.

reversal_criteria.to_REPAIR_REQUIRED: Governed verification demonstrates a material active defect with an attributable minimal target.
reversal_criteria.to_NO_ACTION_SUPPORTED: Currentness, coverage, authority and performance unknowns close without a material defect.
reversal_criteria.to_NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: Required governed evidence cannot be obtained safely or remains ambiguous.
